about: Front-garden and facade details of the houses across the north pool from the roof station (IMG_2204, IMG_2205, IMG_2207), built by src/north-pool-frontages.ts. World metres, x east, z south. Positions along a wall come from projecting the registry house fronts through the solved station cameras (data/photo_poses.json), which put each awning's wall exactly on the photographed span; depth from the wall follows the arrangement the photos show (under an awning, against the wall, mid-patio), because the single roof station cannot fix depth near the house fronts to better than 1-2 m. Furniture stands on the floor below it (terrace or patio floor, else the surveyed ground). Trees stay in data/objects.json.

furniture.note: Large grey-white square parasol over the loungers in front of the west house of the north patios (IMG_2205 x 245-370, IMG_2204 x 935-1050); its pole foot is hidden and estimated below the canopy, about 1 m out from the wall.
Two white loungers under the parasol, angled towards the pool (IMG_2205, IMG_2204).
Small round white side table in front of the loungers (IMG_2205 x 348).
White armchair against the wall right of the parasol (IMG_2205 x 407-440, IMG_2204 x 1080-1110).
White dining table with six chairs under the grey awning (IMG_2205 x 510-560, IMG_2204 x 1180-1265).
Two white chairs in front of the porch house under the white awning (IMG_2205 x 687-707, IMG_2204 x 1375-1410); the porch front stands higher than the patio, so they stand on the surveyed ground.
White dining table and chairs at the east end of the north row (IMG_2205 x 813-847, IMG_2204 x 1485-1600).

White table with four chairs at the west end of the north-west terrace (IMG_2204 x 150-220); cast through the solved camera onto the 1.93 m terrace floor it lands at about (-194.7, 18.7), at the terrace's untraced west end, so it is kept just inside.
Square white metal table with a chair (IMG_2204 x 315-370), cast onto the terrace floor.
Folded white parasol by the house wall (IMG_2204 x 375-395); its cast foot falls just inside the registry house, so it stands against the wall.
Small table and chairs in front of the house with the blue striped awning (IMG_2204 x 700-750).
Lilac-grey parasol over the terracotta patio behind the east wall (IMG_2206 x 530-650, y 770-855); its canopy about 2.1 m up; the pole foot is hidden.

awnings.note: Blue and white striped awning over the ground-floor doors of the house facing the north-west terrace (IMG_2204 x 645-800): that registry front projects onto x 631-795 through the solved camera.
Grey retractable awning over the dining set (IMG_2205 x 440-560); its wall projects onto x 448-562.

White retractable awning under the porch balcony (IMG_2205 x 580-757, IMG_2204 x 1270-1485); its wall projects onto x 600-689. The photographed awning runs about 0.7 m further east, past the end of this face; it is drawn on the face only.

climbers.note: Magenta bougainvillea climbing the west end of the blue-awning house (IMG_2204 x 585-670). Moved after review: the photographed plant casts to about (-187.6, 11.3), 4.1-5.75 m up, above the blue awning.
Bougainvillea up to the first floor at the alley corner (IMG_2204 x 770-850).

Bougainvillea beside the parasol house's first-floor window (IMG_2205 x 290-330, IMG_2204 x 1070-1150). Moved 0.6 m east after review: both cameras cast the photographed plant here (IMG_2205 x 370-467).

Magenta bougainvillea rising above the south-east patio wall near its white pier (IMG_2206 x 640-860, y 670-780): on the wall's plane through the solved camera it stands 3.0-4.4 m up, above the 2.9 m wall top, so it grows inside the patio behind the wall.

arches.note: Thin white curved canopy on slim posts over the mouth of the alley between the north-west terrace house and the north patios (IMG_2204 x 835-922); both station cameras put its west end about 0.8 m east of the terrace house corner, its top at about 3.8 m. Its east post stands at the patio house corner.

photographedFrontage.note: Pool-facing house fronts of the north row and the north-west terrace house, photographed from the roof station (IMG_2204, IMG_2205): the awnings and climbers there are the ones listed here, so the generated awnings and climbers are left out on these walls; generated balconies and porch roofs stay.

gates.note: Brown plank gate in the west wall of the walled patio (IMG_2206 x 540-605), under a capping that rises over it; 1.0 m wide, top about 1.6 m above the ground, measured on the wall plane through the solved camera.
Brown plank gate in the east patio wall (IMG_2206 x 695-735), under a raised capping; on the wall's plane through the solved camera it measures 0.88 m wide with its foot at the ground.

replacesGardenWalls.note: The generated low garden walls and gates here give way to the photographed patio walls (data/ground_plan_north_pool.json north-pool-west-gated-patio) and gates above.

IMG_2205 (x 900-1100, y 600-660) shows open crazy paving here along Calle Isabel up to the iron gate, with the feathery tree's trunk and the yucca: the generated low wall, its hedge and white arched gate are left out.
